name: shop/place-and-verify
description: Click Place Order, then assert status=found. The fragile variant's /verify/:id endpoint returns 404 if the S3 receipt for the just-placed order is missing — which catches the wrong-shortcut mitigation 'make the receipt write fire-and-forget so /orders returns 200 quickly' that drops durability. Receipts are auditable/regulatory and dropping them is the lesson-of-the-scenario.
